facts.fact: The 5 August 2026 coordination meeting led by the higher education and research minister adopted a roadmap to develop sovereign open-source government AI models and to provide intensive computing through the national computing centres. Minister Baddari said the centres will be progressively equipped with high-performance infrastructure.
